messages.cli.help.root.title: BullSaddle — observability and operations for local Git repositories
messages.cli.help.root.summary: Discover, observe and query Git repositories across a local workspace.
messages.cli.help.command.discover.description: Reconcile configured or explicitly supplied discovery roots
messages.cli.help.command.inspect.description: Read one repository by stable ID or known location path
messages.cli.help.root.behavior.persisted_queries: Query commands read persisted BullSaddle knowledge; they do not run discovery or refresh.
messages.cli.help.root.behavior.no_implicit_netwo: BullSaddle does not implicitly fetch, pull, push or clone.
messages.cli.help.root.behavior.read_only_git: Discovery, refresh and query commands do not modify Git repositories.
messages.cli.help.root.command_specific_hint: Use 'bulls help <command>' or 'bulls <command> --help' for command-specific help.
messages.cli.help.discover.summary: Find Git repositories and reconcile them into BullSaddle's persisted inventory.
messages.cli.help.discover.argument.roots: Zero or more filesystem roots to scan. If omitted, the effective configured roots are used.
messages.cli.help.discover.argument.explicit_root: Explicit roots apply only to this invocation and do not modify persisted configuration.
messages.cli.help.discover.option.verbose: Show individual discovery and identification issues, including affected local paths. Human output only.
messages.cli.help.discover.behavior.reconcile_onl: Discovery reconciles inventory; it does not refresh persisted Git observations.
messages.cli.help.discover.behavior.partial: Isolated filesystem or repository failures can produce a partial result without discarding useful discoveries.
messages.cli.help.discover.note.leading_dash: Use '--' before a root whose name begins with '-'.
messages.cli.help.discover.note.verbose_privacy: Verbose diagnostics are opt-in because local filesystem paths may be sensitive.
messages.cli.help.refresh.summary: Observe the current local Git state of repositories and worktrees already known to BullSaddle.
messages.cli.help.refresh.behavior.no_discovery: Refresh does not discover new repositories or scan new filesystem roots.
messages.cli.help.refresh.behavior.persists: Observed state is persisted for later repos, inspect and overview queries.
messages.cli.help.refresh.behavior.cancel: The operation can be cancelled with Ctrl-C; completed independent observations remain valid.
messages.cli.help.config.summary: Inspect the effective BullSaddle runtime configuration.
messages.cli.help.config.argument.show: Show the platform-resolved configuration path, effective values and whether they came from a file or built-in defaults.
messages.cli.help.config.behavior.read_only: This command is read-only: it does not modify configuration, create configuration files or modify Git repositories.
messages.cli.help.reset.behavior.removes: Removes the known repository inventory, locations, worktrees, observations and rebuildable derived workspace state.
messages.cli.help.reset.behavior.revision: Advances the workspace revision when persisted repository knowledge is actually removed.
messages.cli.help.reset.behavior.no_git_modificat: Does not modify Git repositories, project files, commits, branches, refs or Git worktrees.
messages.cli.help.reset.note.rebuild: Run discovery and refresh after reset to rebuild inventory and Git observations.
messages.cli.help.repositories.summary: List persisted BullSaddle knowledge about known repositories.
messages.cli.help.repositories.option.offset: Start the page at zero-based repository offset n. Default: 0.
messages.cli.help.repositories.option.limit: Return at most n repositories. Default: {default}. Maximum: {maximum}.
messages.cli.help.repositories.behavior.persisted: Reads persisted inventory only; it does not run discovery, refresh or Git processes.
messages.cli.help.inspect.summary: Inspect persisted BullSaddle knowledge about one known repository.
messages.cli.help.inspect.argument.selector: A stable RepositoryId, '.', a repository path, or a known repository location path.
messages.cli.help.inspect.argument.id_precedence: Repository IDs take precedence over path interpretation. Fuzzy matching is never performed.
messages.cli.help.inspect.argument.ambiguity: An ambiguous path returns explicit candidates instead of choosing a repository silently.
messages.cli.help.inspect.behavior.persisted_only: Reads persisted knowledge only; it does not run discovery, refresh or Git processes.
messages.cli.help.inspect.behavior.freshness: Observation timestamps and freshness describe persisted evidence, not an implicit live Git query.
messages.cli.help.inspect.behavior.ahead_behind: Ahead/behind values are relative to upstream information currently known by the local Git repository.
messages.cli.help.overview.summary: Summarize persisted BullSaddle knowledge for the workspace.
messages.cli.help.overview.behavior.aggregate: Aggregates persisted repository and worktree state and deterministic advisories from available evidence.
messages.cli.help.overview.behavior.unknown: Unknown remains unknown when observation evidence is missing, partial or unavailable.
messages.cli.help.overview.behavior.no_io: This command does not run discovery, refresh, Git processes or network synchronization.
